title: Guardrails with Human Approval
learning_objectives: Pause a graph with interrupt() to ask a person for approval
Resume it with Command(resume=...) on the same thread
Allow safe actions, require approval for sensitive ones and block unknown ones
entry_point: build_guarded_graph(tools, sensitive); run_with_approval(app, action, thread_id, decide)
hints: The guard node returns `{}` when the action may run, so the router can send it to execute.
`route = lambda s: END if s["outcome"] in ("blocked", "rejected") else "execute"`.

failure_feedback.advice: Resume with Command(resume=decision) on the same thread_id.
Treat anything except 'approve' as a rejection.
Run the tool in the execute node, after the approval, not inside guard.
